text: Come, now don't be shy. Step into the light.
asr: Come now, don't be shy. Step into the light.

text: Those sniveling cowards with their long bows and Black Arrows.
asr: Those sniveling cowards with their long bows and black arrows!

text: Tell me, wretch. How now shall you challenge me?
asr: Tell me, wretch, how now shall you challenge me?
